announcements.headline: Dividend Declaration
announcements.insight: NewRiver REIT declares a dividend following its September 2026 results. This follows the July board appointments and August scrip allotment.

announcements.headline: Results for the period ended 30 September 2026
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled financial results for the specified period, which is a standard regulatory requirement for listed companies. The headline does not indicate the direction or magnitude of the performance, so the impact on shareholders depends entirely on the undisclosed content.

announcements.headline: Notice of Results
announcements.insight: This headline indicates a scheduled results announcement, which is a routine update for shareholders regarding the company's financial performance. The specific direction or magnitude of the results is not disclosed in the headline.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: This announcement relates to director dealings, which typically indicates routine changes in shareholding by individuals with senior management responsibilities. Such disclosures are standard governance requirements and generally carry limited immediate impact on shareholder value unless they signal a significant shift in insider sentiment.

announcements.headline: Scrip dividend share allotment
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the issuance of new shares to shareholders who have elected to receive their dividend in stock rather than cash. It represents a minor capital action that may result in slight dilution for those not participating while providing an alternative income method for others.

announcements.headline: Appointments to the Board
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates a change in the board composition, which is a standard governance update. Such appointments can influence strategic direction but typically do not immediately impact financial performance.

announcements.headline: Annual Report and Accounts and AGM 2026
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of the annual financial results and the convening of the Annual General Meeting, which are standard scheduled events for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Scrip Dividend Reference Price
announcements.insight: This announcement provides the reference price used to calculate the value of shares issued under a scrip dividend option. It allows shareholders to determine the equity dilution or cash alternative associated with their dividend choice.

announcements.headline: Dividend Declaration & Scrip Dividend Scheme
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates a dividend declaration accompanied by a scrip dividend scheme, which allows shareholders to elect for new shares instead of cash. This type of corporate action generally signifies a method for capital retention and potential share dilution rather than a fundamental change in business operations.

announcements.headline: Preliminary results for year ended 31 March 2026
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled annual financial results for the company. It provides shareholders with the official performance data for the specified fiscal year but does not indicate the direction or magnitude of the outcome.

announcements.headline: Full Year Results Details & Investor Presentation
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled full-year financial results and an accompanying investor presentation, which are routine updates for shareholders.
